# Anoop Singh
> Anoop Singh is a Senior Software Engineer and Drupal specialist with 13+ years of experience in front-end architecture, responsive UI/UX, decoupled CMS implementations and custom Drupal theming (Drupal 7 to 11). Based in Jaipur, India; remote-friendly worldwide.

## Professional Overview
- **Role**: Senior Software Engineer at NextOpcode Consulting LLP
- **Expertise**: Custom Drupal theming (Drupal 8+ and Drupal CMS), Acquia Site Studio, HTML, CSS, SCSS and LESS, all Bootstrap versions, Next.js, React, Progressive Web Apps, performance optimization, SEO and accessibility
- **Tools**: Gulp, Koala, Composer, NPM, Drush, DDEV, Docker, Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Pantheon, Acquia, Lighthouse, PageSpeed Insights, GTmetrix, Google Search Console, GA4, Photoshop, Adobe XD, Cursor, Visual Studio and AI assistants (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Google AI Studio)
- **Career start**: Oct 2012 as a data entry operator at Dice Infocom Pvt. Ltd., Jaipur; web designer there from Jan 2013 to Sep 2016, then Maan Softwares, Valuebound, Ekfrazo and NextOpcode
- **Community**: Drupal.org contributor with 5+ custom themes, 7+ maintained projects and 125+ issue credits
